items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about Rick; the interviewer mentions Rick in the context of medical issues/pain, and the interviewee's only response is to offer a chair/microphone setup, showing no personal or professional connection.

ctx.x: I taught violin. You taught the clarinet by myself. We're probably talking about violin. Yeah, I taught the clarinet by myself.
You learned the clarinet by yourself? Mm-hmm. Who were some of the best clarinet players you heard in those days? Who did you like? George Buckley. Oh, my name is Rick.
No, no. Oh, my Rick did play the clarinet.
